invariants.S7: Saf türetme yardımcıları (enforcementTone/guardrailTone/modelStatusTone/profileStatusTone/countEnabledGuardrails/mandatoryGuardrailCount/policyGaps/noTrainViolations/countByModelStatus/allowedModelCount/activeProfileCount/coveredTenants) deterministik; Date.now/rastgelelik yok.
